name: FixAm — Premium UI/UX Specification
audience: Devin (implementation). This file is the single source of truth for visual design, interaction, motion and UX copy. It supersedes the old specs/design-tokens.json.
how_to_use: Implement the tokens in section 'tokens' as CSS variables in app/globals.css and expose them through the Tailwind theme (@theme). Never hardcode colours, radii, shadows or durations in components.
Build every component in 'components' with class-variance-authority (cva) variants on top of shadcn/ui primitives, in components/ui (primitives) and components/brand (FixAm-specific).
Put motion presets in lib/motion.ts and import them; never write ad-hoc spring values in components.
Maintain a living catalogue at /design (dev and preview only) showing every token, component, variant and state in light, dark and sunlight modes.
Each screen in 'surfaces' must implement all of its listed states (loading, empty, error, offline, success) before its task is considered done.
Add Playwright visual snapshots for /design and for each primary screen in light and dark mode.

vision.one_liner: Premium, calm and fast for the work; joyful at the moments that matter.
vision.summary: FixAm keeps its bold Ghanaian energy and Ignition Orange identity, executed with the restraint of a top-tier SaaS. Daily work screens are quiet, precise and dense where needed (Linear/Stripe). Money feels confident and delightful (Revolut/Monzo). Customers get live, glanceable status like tracking a ride (Uber/Bolt). Mechanics and customers get characterful encouragement and celebrations (Duolingo). Fun is concentrated in moments, never in the way of work.

principles.name: Calm core, joyful moments
principles.rule: Work screens use neutral surfaces and one accent. Colour, illustration and animation intensify only at milestones: job ready, payment received, streak kept, renewal done.

principles.name: Speed is a feature
principles.rule: Every interaction responds within 100ms (optimistic UI). Pages show skeletons, never spinners on blank screens. Keyboard shortcuts on desktop; one-thumb flows on mobile.

principles.name: Status at a glance
principles.rule: Any job, vehicle, invoice or renewal reveals its state in under one second via the status system: colour + icon + label, never colour alone.

principles.name: Thumb-first, glove-proof
principles.rule: Primary actions sit in the bottom 40% of mobile screens. Touch targets ≥ 48px (56px on mechanic screens).

principles.name: Money is sacred
principles.rule: Amounts are large, tabular and unambiguous. Destructive or financial actions confirm with a clear summary. Never animate a number in a way that could be misread.

principles.name: Built for Ghana
principles.rule: Works on mid-range Android over patchy 3G/4G, in bright sunlight, with MoMo as the default payment. Low-data mode and offline states are first-class.

principles.name: Respectful delight
principles.rule: Every celebration and sound can be turned off; prefers-reduced-motion is always honoured; no confetti on anything involving debt, refunds or errors.

gradients.rule: Gradients only on: primary CTA hover glow, money cards, hero sections, celebration surfaces, marketing. Never on body text or tables.

sunlight.name: Sunlight (high contrast)
sunlight.purpose: Outdoor use in the yard; toggle in user menu and auto-suggested on mechanic screens when ambient light API is available.

status.rule: Every status renders as StatusPill = icon + label + colour. Lists also show a 3px leading colour bar.

data_viz.rule: Follow the dataviz skill conventions; one highlighted series in ignition, others muted.

display.name: Bricolage Grotesque
display.use: Page titles, hero numbers, celebration headlines, marketing

mono.name: Geist Mono
mono.use: Plate numbers, document numbers, codes, keyboard hints

body.note: 16 on mobile to avoid iOS zoom in inputs

typography.numbers: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero for all money, quantities, mileage, times. Currency symbol at 60% size, aligned to cap height (Revolut style) on hero amounts.
typography.plate_chip: Geist Mono 600, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.08em, on a Ghana-plate inspired chip: white bg, 1.5px carbon border, small left flag stripe (red/gold/green 3px each) — original styling, not an official plate reproduction.

layout.grid: 12 columns desktop / 8 tablet / 4 mobile, 24px gutters desktop, 16px mobile

density.comfortable: row height 52px, default for most users
density.compact: row height 40px, toggle for desktop tables (owners, accountants, storekeepers)

elevation.rule: Premium depth = soft layered shadows + hairline borders. The old chunky offset shadow is retained only as the 'pop' accent for playful components (badges, celebration cards, mascot speech bubbles, empty-state cards).
elevation.dark_mode: Shadows at 2× opacity plus a 1px top inner highlight rgba(255,255,255,0.04) on raised surfaces.

glass.fallback: Solid surface when backdrop-filter unsupported, in low-data mode, or in sunlight mode

iconography.rule: Icons in pills and buttons 16/20. Duotone treatment (primary-subtle fill + stroke) for feature icons in empty states and onboarding.

choreography: Page enter: content fades up 8px with 30ms stagger per section, max 6 staggered items
Route change: View Transitions API cross-fade (fallback: Framer Motion) with shared-element morph from list card to detail header (plate chip + car avatar)
Lists: new rows slide in from top with highlight flash (primary-subtle → transparent, 1.2s)
Kanban drop: card lifts (scale 1.03, elevation 3) while dragging; settles with 'snappy' spring; column count ticks
Status change: pill colour cross-fades and icon morphs; one gentle bounce
Bottom sheets: 'sheet' spring with drag-to-dismiss and velocity
Buttons: press scale 0.97 'snappy'; primary shows glow-primary on hover
Numbers: money uses digit roll only on positive confirmations (payment received); never on editing or debt
motion.reduced_motion: Replace all movement with 120ms opacity; disable confetti, Lottie, digit roll, parallax and shared-element morphs.
motion.haptics: navigator.vibrate on Android: 8ms tap on kanban drop and checklist tick; [12,40,12] on payment success; never on errors more than once.

sound.rules: ≤ 40KB each, preloaded lazily, toggle in profile, never on customer pages by default.

brand_elements.logo_direction: Wordmark 'FixAm' in Bricolage Grotesque 700 with a custom ligature where the 'x' doubles as a crossed wrench and spanner. Mark: rounded-square app icon in ignite gradient with the wrench-x in white. Provide SVG wordmark, mark, monochrome and favicon variants (original design).

mascot.name: Torq
mascot.concept: An original, friendly round robot-wrench character: a rounded bolt-head body in Ignition Orange, big expressive eyes on a carbon visor, small spanner arms. Simple vector shapes so it renders crisply at 24px to 240px.
mascot.implementation: SVG React components with props pose, size, mood; idle blink animation (CSS, 4–7s random). Optional Lottie for celebrate and wave only.
rules: Never appears in financial confirmations, legal text or error states about money
Garages can turn Torq off for customer-facing pages (setting: mascot_on_customer_pages)

brand_elements.car_avatars: Original flat vector car illustrations per body type (sedan, hatchback, SUV, pickup, van, bus, truck, motorbike), three-quarter view, tinted from vehicle.color_hex with automatic shade/highlight, soft ground shadow. Used in cards (40px), headers (96px), tracker hero (240px).
brand_elements.illustration_style: Flat shapes with soft gradients, 2px carbon outlines only on the mascot and avatars, warm sand backgrounds, small Ghana-inspired pattern accents (kente-inspired geometric stripes as subtle dividers, original pattern) used sparingly on marketing and celebration screens.
brand_elements.photography: Real workshop photos from users are the hero on job and tracker screens; display in rounded md frames with a subtle inner border; tap to open a full-screen swipeable gallery with pinch-zoom.

voice_and_copy.tone: Warm, confident, brief, a little playful. Ghanaian flavour without slang overload. Plain English for money, legal and errors.
rules: Verbs on buttons: 'Send estimate', 'Check in car', 'Pay GH₵ 450'
Show the amount on pay buttons
Errors say what happened and what to do next

types: money (GH₵ prefix, tabular, right-aligned in tables)
Input.label: Always visible label above; helper text below; floating labels not used

components.Select/Combobox: Searchable, async, keyboard navigable; shows recent items first; create-new inline ('+ Add new customer "Kojo"').
components.DatePicker: Calendar popover on desktop, native-feel bottom sheet on mobile; quick picks (Today, Tomorrow, +1 week, +1 month).
components.StatusPill: Icon + label, sizes sm/md, subtle (tinted bg) and solid variants; colour from tokens.color.status.
components.PlateChip: See typography.plate_chip; sizes sm/md/lg; copy-on-click on desktop.
components.CarAvatar: See brand_elements.car_avatars; props bodyType, colorHex, size, showShadow.
components.VehicleHealthCard: CarAvatar + four HealthRings (Oil, Insurance, DVLA, Issues) + 'FixAm Score' 0–100 + next-due line; tap ring opens detail sheet. Rings animate fill on first view (gentle spring).
components.HealthRing: Circular progress with status colour, icon centre, label below, days-left text.
components.MoneyText: Formats pesewas to GH₵; sizes body to display-xl; negative uses danger with minus sign (never brackets alone); optional 'hidden' mode with tap-to-reveal for privacy.
components.MoneyCard: Gradient card with big amount, label, delta chip and sparkline (Revolut style).
components.StatTile: Label, big display number, delta chip (▲ volt / ▼ brake), sparkline, link.
components.DataTable: TanStack; sticky header; column resize, hide, reorder; row selection with bulk action bar sliding up from bottom; inline status pills; keyboard navigation (j/k, enter); density toggle; saved views; skeleton rows; empty state with Torq; mobile collapses to cards.
components.KanbanBoard: Columns with sticky headers and counts, WIP soft limits (column tints warning when exceeded), swimlanes optional, drag with auto-scroll, card quick actions on hover (desktop) / long-press (mobile).
components.JobCard: Plate chip, car avatar 40px, make/model, customer name, complaint snippet (1 line), assignee avatars, promised-time countdown chip (turns warning < 1h, danger overdue), priority flag, balance chip when ready, photo count.
components.Timeline: Vertical activity feed with icons, actor avatars, relative times, grouped by day; customer-visible items marked with an eye icon for staff.
components.Stepper: Horizontal (desktop) / vertical (mobile); completed steps with volt check; current step pulses softly; used in tracker, renewals, onboarding, check-in.
components.BottomSheet: Mobile primary container for details and actions; snap points (peek 25%, half 55%, full 92%); drag handle; glass over imagery.
components.SideSheet: Desktop detail panel (480–640px) sliding from right; keeps list visible (Linear style); deep-linkable via URL.
components.Dialog: For confirmations only; financial confirmations show a summary table and require explicit action label (e.g. 'Issue invoice INV-SPX-000123').
components.Toast: Bottom-centre on mobile, bottom-right on desktop; types success/info/warning/error; undo action for reversible operations (5s).
components.CommandPalette: ⌘K / Ctrl+K and search icon; sections: Jump to (plates, customers, jobs, invoices), Actions (Check in car, New booking, Record payment, Counter sale), Recent; fuzzy search; glass surface; shows shortcuts.
components.EmptyState: Torq pose + headline + one-line body + primary action + optional secondary link; pop card variant.
components.Skeleton: Shapes match final layout; shimmer per tokens.motion.
components.OfflineBanner: Slim top banner (warning-subtle) with sync queue count; turns volt 'All synced ✓' for 2s when back online.
components.SyncBadge: Per-item indicator on mechanic screens: queued (clock), syncing (spinner), synced (check), failed (retry).
components.PhotoCapture: Full-screen camera with guide overlays for walk-around shots (front, rear, left, right, interior, odometer), retake, auto-compress to WebP, upload progress ring per photo.
components.MoMoPayment: Network picker with brand-neutral network tiles (MTN, Telecel, AirtelTigo as text labels), phone input pre-filled, 'Approve on your phone' waiting state with countdown and animated phone illustration, success/failure states.
components.ProgressBar: Plan/instalment progress with segments per instalment (paid volt, due sun, overdue brake).
components.Badge: Achievement badges: circular, violet/ignite gradients, pop shadow, locked state greyscale with progress hint.
components.StreakFlame: Animated flame icon with count; grey when streak at risk today.
components.Avatar: Initials fallback with deterministic warm colour; online dot for staff.
components.Tabs/SegmentedControl: Underline tabs on desktop pages; segmented pill control on mobile and filters.
components.FilterBar: Chips with counts, 'Saved views' dropdown, clear all.
components.MapView: MapLibre GL with a FixAm light/dark style; garage pin uses mark icon; vendor delivery shows route line and moving van marker when location updates exist; static image fallback in low-data mode.

navigation.desktop: Collapsible left sidebar (icons + labels, section groups, garage switcher at top, branch switcher below), sticky glass top bar with breadcrumbs, command palette trigger, notifications, theme toggle, profile.
navigation.mobile: Glass bottom tab bar (max 5, role-specific, centre FAB '+ Check in' for advisors/owners), top bar with title and contextual action, swipe-back gestures.

patterns.list_detail: Desktop: list + side sheet (no full page change) for jobs, customers, vehicles, invoices. Mobile: list → full-screen detail with shared-element transition.
patterns.forms: Single column, grouped sections, sticky bottom action bar on mobile, autosave drafts for long forms (check-in, estimates), inline validation on blur, never clear user input on error.

confirmation_levels.high: Dialog with summary (issue invoice, refund, void, exceed credit limit)

patterns.loading: Skeletons within 100ms; if > 3s show Torq 'thinking' with reassuring copy; optimistic updates for status changes, checklist ticks, notes.
patterns.errors: Inline field errors; section-level error cards with retry; full-page error with Torq 'oops' only for fatal errors; payment errors always state whether money was taken.
patterns.offline_low_data: Detect navigator.connection.saveData or slow-2g/2g/3g: switch to low-data mode (no glass, static maps, thumbnails at 480px, no Lottie, no autoplay). User can toggle in profile.

realtime presence avatars on cards being viewed
keyboard: arrows move focus, M to move status

definition_of_premium: Pixel-aligned to the 4pt grid; no orphaned spacing values
Consistent radii and elevation per component type
Every screen has designed loading, empty, error and offline states
Motion feels intentional: nothing animates without a reason; nothing janks (60fps on a mid-range Android)
Copy is short, human and consistent with voice_and_copy
Dark and sunlight modes are fully designed, not inverted
Money screens pass a 'would I trust this with my cash?' review
review_checklist_per_pr: Screens in light, dark, sunlight at 360px, 768px, 1280px attached
Lighthouse mobile performance ≥ 85, accessibility ≥ 95 on changed routes
No hardcoded colours/sizes (lint rule: no raw hex in components)
quality_bar.visual_qa: Playwright screenshot tests for /design and primary screens per theme; fail on > 0.2% pixel diff unless snapshot updated in the PR.

open_inputs_from_peter: Final logo (or approve the wrench-x wordmark direction)
Approve Torq mascot concept and name
Pilot garage photos for marketing and onboarding
Default garage accent policy (allow custom colours on customer pages: yes/no)
